name: Neunkirchen-Seelscheid (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and white, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Neunkirchen-Seelscheid (a red lion on white above yellow figures on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Neunkirchen-Seelscheid; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
